question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

All eyes and ears
solution:
Here the correct answer is **To be attentive.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the given idiom:-
 
• **All eyes and ears** - Eagerly giving one's full attention to something. (किसी चीज पर अपना पूरा ध्यान लगाना)
 
 
• Example: The journalists were **all eyes and ears** at the press conference.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
